message.content: The drive from San Francisco to Los Angeles is roughly 380–400 miles (about 610–640 km) along the I‑5 corridor. Under normal conditions—no major traffic jams or detours—it typically takes **around 6 to 6½ hours**. In peak traffic periods (especially near the Bay Area or the Los Angeles metro area), you might add an extra hour or two, so plan for **7–8 hours** if you’re traveling during rush hour or holiday weekends.
